## 1. Professional Profile & Key Battle Metrics

### Wise (Nov 2024 – Present) · Product Engineer 3 (Tech Owner)
- **Financial AI Automation & Evaluation Infrastructure**: Architected an end-to-end AI evaluation and execution platform from scratch for last-mile payment linking without golden datasets; engineered deterministic DAG state machines with real-time live shadowing against PayOps, 99.5% accuracy gating, and a 5% canary control stream with sub-second circuit-breaker failover.
- **Payment Defects Automation**: Automated 30,000+ complex payment defect cases monthly with 98%+ accuracy across heterogeneous currency and clearing rail rules; designed risk-tiered blast radius controls (large-amount threshold gating to human review), yielding £80,000/month (~£1M/year) direct operational savings.
- **Compensation & Escalation Platform**: Re-architected global multi-currency Compensation Platform with automated compliance checks and maker-checker controls; built a Kafka-based cross-team escalation pipeline between Customer Support and PayOps, leveraging structured defect telemetry to eliminate upstream ticket causes.

### ByteDance / TikTok (Jan 2021 – Sep 2023) · Senior Backend Engineer
- **Promotions & Awards**: Promoted in 1 year; awarded Spot Bonus; received top performance rating (E / Exceeds Expectations).
- **TikTok IM Presence Engine**: Mitigated multi-million QPS broadcast storms during user status changes by engineering a hybrid push-pull protocol with active heartbeat gating via Redis ZSET, eliminating O(N*M) write amplification by restricting push dispatches exclusively to online, active friends.
- **Typing Indicator & Read Receipts**: Implemented ultra-low latency signaling mechanisms for Read Receipts and Typing Indicators across multi-data-center infrastructure; designed client-side debouncing and batch aggregation to eliminate transient signaling spikes while maintaining sub-100ms response.
- **Latency Tuning & Cold-Start Inbox Ranking**: Overhauled inbox cold-start loading via ZSET active conversation hierarchies to replace append-only DB table scans (delivering sub-100ms initialization for newly re-installed apps); optimized cross-region RPC payloads and routing paths to reduce P99 latency.
- **Overseas Location Platform**: Sole engineer in Singapore independently governing overseas IP geo-location infrastructure (~100 offline Spark batch jobs and Go microservices); overhauled alert rules to eliminate oncall alarm fatigue, tuned Go runtime memory/GC profiles, and improved ASEAN geo-accuracy (Spot Bonus & Top E).
- **API Gateway (AGW)**: Developed automated self-diagnosis and capacity estimation tools for PaaS gateway routing millions of QPS during Chinese New Year (CNY) live traffic campaigns.

### MariBank & Bondee (2023 – 2024)
- **MariBank (Sea Group)**: Digital banking core credit services (Cashloan & SME Termloan) in Java, enforcing distributed transaction consistency, idempotency, and anti-replay patterns under MAS regulatory compliance. Built an internal RAG assistant.
- **Bondee**: Employee #1 in Singapore; established cloud-native foundation, orchestrated multi-tenant K8s environments, and deployed self-hosted Vector + Kafka + ElasticSearch observability pipelines to replace costly managed logging stacks.

### Education & Roots
- **Nanyang Technological University (NTU)**: B.Eng. (Honors) in Computer Engineering (2017 – 2021). Full NTU Science and Engineering Undergraduate Merit Scholarship (top 1%).
- **U-Wave (Co-Founder, 2019 – 2021)**: Built campus lifestyle platform to 20,000 registered users and 4,000 DAU. Rebuilt cross-platform mobile client with Flutter and architected backend microservices with Spring Cloud, Docker, and Redis.

## 3. Core Architectural Writings & Articles
